config.event_definition: connected components of the exact union of received source masks
config.frame_grid: equal-duration bins covering the full scene; occupancy-fraction targets
config.heldout_claim: joint background/source/propagation shift, not an isolated causal family ablation
config.selection: minimum development clip BCE plus 0.5 frame BCE; all three epochs
config.snr_definition: per-source received RMS SNR over its own support, not total mixture SNR
config.source_claim: harmonic/AM/chirp acoustic-like sources, not real vessel classes

limitations: Received union activity, not separated physical objects.
Controlled simulator does not establish realism or transfer.
Heldout source, background and propagation changes are joint.
Same-family SNR conditions reuse scenes and are paired; family conditions are not exactly paired.
Frames use equal-duration scene bins; interval precision is approximately 128 ms.
